newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia nabs man behind "robbery of the century".
newsitem.headline: Colombia nabs man behind "robbery of the century".

text.p: Police have nabbed the man who masterminded Colombia's "robbery of the century," the theft of $24 million from a central bank office two years ago.
El Tiempo, Colombia's leading daily, said Benigno Suarez Rincon was arrested on Thursday by police posing as peasants in the coffee-growing region of Quindio in central Colombia.

Suarez Rincon, nicknamed "Don Pacho" and a lieutenant of late Medellin cartel drug lord Gonzalo Rodriguez Gacha, had been the target of a nationwide manhunt ever since the central bank heist in the northern city of Valledupar in October 1994.
El Tiempo said he is also believed to be responsible for a bank job in Bogota in 1991 in which thieves tunneled their way into a branch of the Caja Agraria bank and made off with $15 milllion.
According to El Tiempo, 32 other people have already been convicted for their role in the Valledupar theft.
